title: A formal textile charter is granted to Gharnāṭa: the silk and cloth of the city have become a pillar of the realm's economy
Roads are built through the mountains around Gharnāṭa: south to al-Mariyya, and north-east to the saffron fields of Wādī Āsh and Basṭa
source: Trent's account (late 1356; the exact day isn't given)

title: Libraries rise in the cities of the south, and soon will in the north, to carry Islam and Andalusī learning back into Qurṭuba and the lands purged of them during the Castilian occupation

data.aim: spread Islam and Andalusi culture northward
